llm_response.reason: The website at https://zanquoreli.my/ simply displays a replica of the Google Japan home page and links to Google's actual resources, yet it is registered under a domain name with no relationship to Google. There is no legitimate company or product information, which mimics the design of a popular legitimate service using an unrelated domain (scam characteristic #16). Such imitation is typical in phishing, scam, or malicious intent sites meant to deceive users and/or harvest information.
